mutants.description: Green_LED is updated only while the converter is switching and keeps its last value in S_OFF, S_HICCUP and S_LATCHED, instead of going dark whenever the converter is not switching
mutants.reason: A window trip is left out of currently_faulted, so it takes the supervisor from S_RUN to S_HICCUP while Green_LED is lit. With this fault Green_LED then stays lit through the whole hiccup off-time. It also stays lit in S_OFF after a fault-free shutdown.

mutants.description: Strike blink is shown only while exactly one strike is outstanding, as if strike_level were a single strike flag rather than a count
mutants.reason: If a second hiccup happens before clean_run_target clears the strikes, strike_level reaches 2 or more. Red_LED1 then goes dark instead of blinking, while strikes are still outstanding and no latch is set.
